item.title: House set to vote to impeach Hegseth. And, SCOTUS allows border wall work to proceed
item.description: The House could vote to impeach Hegseth, but removing him from office will be tough. And, SCOTUS ruled that a federal judge did not have the authority to halt border wall construction.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: U.S.-mediated talks on ending Russia-Ukraine war begin in Abu Dhabi
item.description: The two-day session in the UAE's capital, Abu Dhabi, is the first such meeting since February. It will focus on security guarantees, the White House said before the discussions.

item.description: President Trump's top envoy is in Abu Dhabi with negotiators from Russia and Ukraine to resume peace talks.

item.title: France accuses Iran of cyber 'sabotage' in fridge attacks
item.description: France says Iranian military hackers took over refrigeration controllers at around 700 different retail sites last month, turning up temperatures in the middle of the night and spoiling millions of dollars' worth of food.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: What Trump meant when he said the U.S. is cutting aid to Israel
item.description: President Trump says he's halting aid to Israel. Israelis are worried. But experts say the U.S. is just shifting aid from the State Department to the Pentagon, with less congressional oversight.

item.title: Thick smog shrouds New Delhi after Diwali firecrackers add to seasonal pollution
item.description: New Delhi, home to over 30 million people, regularly ranks among the world's most polluted areas during winter, with pollution worsening in late October and November.

item.title: British comedian Russell Brand sentenced to over 10 years for rape and sexual assault
item.description: Russell Brand, who became a celebrity darling in the early 2000s, was found guilty on one count of rape and three counts of sexual assault in a case brought by six women.
